sights.n: Former Sōma Residence (旧相馬家住宅)
sights.w: Merchant Sōma Teppei's 1908 Japanese-Western house beside the Old Public Hall he paid for — an Important Cultural Property with a kura gallery of Esashi screens.
A four-pointed earthwork fort thrown up in days by ~300 Republic of Ezo soldiers and locals in 1869 to shield Goryōkaku — a national historic site park 3 km north.

sights.n: Iai Gakuin Former Missionaries' Residence (遺愛学院旧宣教師館)
sights.w: On the campus of the first girls' school north of Tokyo (1882) — the clapboard missionary house and main hall are Important Cultural Properties, opened on set days.

sights.n: Kitami Hakka Memorial Museum & Mint Distillery (北見ハッカ記念館・薄荷蒸溜館)
sights.w: The 1934 Western-style office of the Hokuren mint plant from when Kitami grew ~70% of the world's mint — with a working steam-distillation house next door.

sights.address: Utoro, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 60 m sea stack by Utoro port, one of the 'Shiretoko Eight Views' — 200-odd steps to a flat top over the Okhotsk and the Shiretoko range (summit access closed for works in 2022; check).

sights.n: Ten ni Tsuzuku Michi — Road to Heaven, Shari (天に続く道)
sights.address: Minehama, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 28.1 km dead-straight stretch of road rolling over the Shari hills toward the sky — twice a year the sun sets exactly at its end.

sights.address: Lake Tōya (by Tōyako Kisen cruise from Tōyako Onsen), Tōyako, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The four forested islands at the heart of the caldera lake — the Espoir cruise lands you at the Nakajima Lake Forest Museum and its Ezo-deer trails.
